recent.text: Danny Briere said he’s not aware of any issues between Michkov and Tocchet. In regards to rifts with vets, he compared the relationship to how siblings fight & it’s natural for guys to be frustrated when the team is losing. Said, “I’m not worried. I’m glad they don’t accept it.”

recent.text: Danny Briere doesn't like to discuss contract negotiations through the media, so he declined talking about a possible extension with Matvei Michkov. But he said when a new deal happens, people will know.
